title: FINNY Wins the 2026 Wealthie for AI Marketing and Lead Generation
summary: FINNY’s Hunter Growth Agent won the Artificial Intelligence – Marketing and Lead Generation category at the 2026 Wealth Management Industry Awards, FINNY’s second straight win in the category.
body_markdown:
FINNY’s Hunter Growth Agent has won the Artificial Intelligence – Marketing and Lead Generation category at the[2026 Wealth Management Industry Awards](https://informaconnect.com/wealth-management-industry-awards/winners/) , known across the industry as the Wealthies. It’s the second year in a row FINNY has won the category, after taking it in 2025 for its AI-enabled organic growth engine.


WealthManagement.com presented this year’s awards at Cipriani 42nd Street in New York City. Now in its 12th year, the program[drew a record 1,392 nominations from 508 companies](https://www.wealthmanagement.com/wealth-management-industry-awards/wealthmanagement-com-celebrates-top-companies-executives-at-2026-industry-awards) . Winners are chosen by independent judges, who evaluate the usefulness, innovation, scope and impact of each initiative.


> "We're proud of the work that has gone into making FINNY the AI platform financial advisors rely on for marketing and growth. We have an exceptional team of engineers building the architecture, workflows and intelligence underneath it. Most of that work is invisible to the end user by design: what advisors see is simple because of the depth of engineering behind it," said **Theo Janson, Co-founder and CTO of FINNY** .


Thank you to WealthManagement.com for the recognition, and congratulations to this year’s other winners and finalists.
